title: Lauta Diya Janaza
body:
gham se dil e rasool e zaman kat raha hai aaj
dunya mein fatema ka chaman kat raha hai aaj
<<DIVIDER>>
lauta diya janaza ummat ne kyun hassan ka
rauze pe mustafa ke jhagda kiya dafan ka
lauta diya janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
aayi sada e girya ek jannatul baqi se
kya haal kar diya hai logon mere chaman ka
lauta diya janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke sar ko chooma farmeina ye hassan ne
fizza khayaal rakhna ab tu meri behan ka
lauta diya janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
qasim ne roke poocha maadar se ye batao
rang laal hogaya hai baba ke kyun kafan ka
lauta diya janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
ek aan mein jigar ke kitne huwe hai tukde
lab rayz hogaya hai paymana bhi lagan ka
lauta diya janaza...
<<DIVIDER>>
rone ke waaste kya tauqeer itna kam hai
nana ke paas rauza ban na saka hassan ka
lauta diya janaza...
author: Tauqeer Kamalvi
